name: Libri-Light
description: A large-scale corpus of English audiobooks derived from LibriVox, designed for self-supervised speech representation learning and evaluation across labeled-data regimes.
citation: Kahn, J., Lee, A., and Hannun, A. (2020). Libri-Light: A Benchmark for ASR with Limited or No Supervision. IEEE International Conference on Acoustics, Speech and Signal Processing (ICASSP). https://arxiv.org/abs/1912.07875

license.notes: The dataset is distributed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International, which is not a standard SPDX identifier in this record. The underlying LibriVox recordings are public domain in the United States; users should verify rights in their jurisdiction and comply with attribution requirements.
